column3: China’s CXMT expects up to $8.2b Q3 profit on AI demand
column4: CXMT ranked fourth in global DRAM revenue in Q2, behind Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron.

column3: Bolt Graphics seeks US$100 million to challenge Nvidia, AMD beyond AI with Zeus GPU
column4: US chip startup Bolt Graphics is seeking approximately US$100 million at a valuation of about US$700 million to develop graphics processors targeting scientific computing and professional rendering, challenging Nvidia and AMD in markets beyond AI acceleration.

column3: Samsung to break ground on second Texas chip fab in November
column4: Samsung Electronics plans to begin construction of its second semiconductor fabrication plant in Taylor, Texas, in November 2026, moving ahead with its US foundry expansion as its first facility prepares to begin operations by the end of the year.

column3: Holtek targets higher-value MCU markets with AI server cooling orders set to lift 2027 revenue
column4: Taiwan-based microcontroller (MCU) manufacturer Holtek Semiconductor unveiled its 2026 product roadmap on October 15, focusing on four core areas: smart protection, green energy and intelligent control, edge AI computing, and general-purpose applications.
